author: Marvel YouTube
text:
Avengers: Age of Ultron | Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez continue their rewatch of The Infinity Saga with Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Age of Ultron. They chat all things Vision, Ultron’s rise to power, and what it takes to lift Mjolnir. They also discuss Sokovia’s destruction as a turning point for the Avengers team, and how those fractures will echo throughout future films.
